title: SETU Food — Your First Order, Tap by Tap
angle: Tutorial-first: after a 13-second promise opener, the walkthrough runs as eight numbered chapters (01 Sign in → 08 Track & hand over) tracked by a story-style progress rail. Every caption names the exact button to tap; every tap is a ripple at the real element's mark followed by the real resulting screen, with transitions that tie action to result (ADD → stepper, View cart pill → cart, cart ₹150 → checkout amount, map pin → saved address). The promise comes from the app's own web panel (Campus only · Commission None · Payment Direct); honesty beats are explicit (DEMO labels during the code sign-in, one sample-stalls note, a time-lapse tag, the labelled demo QR); the end card carries the verbatim disclaimer.

scenes.accuracyNotes: Status headlines and progress labels as captured (Placed, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready, Out for delivery, Delivered). The stall delivers — no rider tracking or map view, and no delivery-time promise (the 'usually ready by …' line is a prep target; never quote its time). Real waits spanned about 20 minutes, hence the TIME-LAPSE tag. Handover order: pay cash → the stall confirms the cash → the customer tells the code → 'Delivered · handover code verified · ₹150 paid in cash'. Code digits exactly as captured. Use each capture's own marks — panel positions move with thread length. Review: 5 stars → 'Excellent' → 'Submit review' (rating can also be done later from Orders).
